t: The Hager Sollysta WMSS81 13A 1-gang switched socket is a reliable electrical accessory designed for professional installation in domestic or commercial properties. This white wall socket features a raised slim profile and a screwed faceplate for a secure fitting, requiring a 25mm back box. It incorporates a 3-part safety shutter and double pole switching for enhanced user protection. Electricians benefit from clear terminal markings and all terminal screws are grouped in-line and upward facing to simplify connections.
b: Upward Facing Backed-Out Captive Terminal Screws
Double Pole Switching On Switched Sockets
